carlingiti: They issued Otto Carlingiti a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a bullet that missed him in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Otto Carlingiti was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F12 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.

An empty jam tin became Otto Carlingiti's cup. The first drink tasted faintly of strawberries. He took smaller sips than usual. Verdel Ridge is lost. Otto Carlingiti heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Otto Carlingiti and Zeno Ramsey split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

Otto Carlingiti kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. The new duty roster listed Otto Carlingiti as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

A shell splinter the size of a fist hit Otto Carlingiti at S-F12. He is alive and he is in pain, and he needs a bed. Outside the aid post, Otto Carlingiti lies on a stretcher among the others. The orderlies step over him and say soon. A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Otto Carlingiti watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

The bearers moved Otto Carlingiti's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close.
There was never a bed for Otto Carlingiti, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F12 on his own feet.

Two men fed the belt while Otto Carlingiti held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Albin Zgz was grazed. A bullet hit Otto Carlingiti in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F12. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Lucien Raphoto of the Concord (@r.raphoto). A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close.
Otto Carlingiti spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.

Otto Carlingiti healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Otto Carlingiti did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close.
j._.inspace: They issued Quentin Inspace a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a cracked shaving mirror in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
mister_funni_man: Day 9: Nils Man reached R-C2 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Nils Man had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs was badly wounded. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-C2 with the rations. Nils Man ate while listening to the revised orders.
nicola.bachini: The draft reached R-R9 on Day 9. Teodor Bachini was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

A round came through the loophole Teodor Bachini was watching at R-R9 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Hugo Blasian of the Hegemony (@blasian117). Teodor Bachini was killed at R-R9 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Hugo Blasian of the Hegemony (@blasian117).
The House of Bachini sent Karel Bachini after Teodor Bachini. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
nishchay_thegreat: Hugo Thegreat came from Belmonte, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Hugo Thegreat looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
stinkyzebraballs: Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
temperedshed: The new sapper is Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed, once a baker from Belmonte. The corporal asked if a baker was any use in a trench. Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed said he would find out.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
thedeepnotes: Matthias Thedeepnotes, a clockmaker from Old Harrow, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in P-F3. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
theverb95: Arno "Parson" Theverb took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Arno "Parson" Theverb lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-C12 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Norbert "Shadow" Slush was gravely wounded. Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Arno "Parson" Theverb watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
